`index.html` is written in the workspace root — a single self-contained file with:

- Pulse app shell: top bar (wordmark, date-range control, avatar) and left nav (Overview, Funnels, Retention, Settings; horizontal tab bar below 820px)
- Four KPI cards with the exact required values and deltas
- A responsive 12-point inline SVG line chart with hairline gridlines, endpoint label, crosshair tooltip, keyboard inspection, and an expandable data table
- The five-event table with Event / Count / Users / Trend, plus a compact footer

The markup and required copy were verified statically. The sandbox blocked launching a browser, so I couldn't capture screenshots at 375/1440.
